findings.title: cqw responsive renderer is incompatible with the sanitizer
findings.problem: The design requires container-type/container-name and cqw, but the shared allowlist does not allow container-type or container-name, so sanitization can remove the containing block and break wide/narrow scaling.
findings.fix: Allow and test the container properties through both sanitizers, or choose an allowed transform/scale implementation; add unsupported-container evidence semantics.

findings.title: Empty-manifest parity is skipped by the audit caller
findings.problem: The caller does not invoke compareContentCollections when both observed manifests are empty, and visual validation can pass an empty Deck-required set without the plan manifest.
findings.fix: Always compare the plan-required manifest; allow pass only when the expected set is empty; add a non-empty-plan/empty-observation regression test.

findings.title: Cover identity IDs are not connected to a required-content contract
findings.problem: The design names four cover IDs, but current normalization/required collection does not include the title or cover keyPoints, while layout nodes have no IDs.
findings.fix: Define a cover normalization manifest with exact source mapping, IDs, roles, order, and cardinality; have Deck and HTML derive from it and test the target fixture.

findings.title: Strict generation can still yield a persistable non-pass candidate
findings.problem: Recoverable strict issues still produce a Deck, and finalization catches Deck failures and returns HTML without a defined persistence block; render-deck currently calls legacy planToDeck.
findings.fix: Propagate PlanToDeckResult into the candidate gate; require pass for verified acceptance, or explicitly mark legacy_unverified and reject verified save/export. Do not treat caught Deck failure as successful candidate output.

findings.title: PPTX/export callers can bypass the integrity boundary
findings.problem: HTML fallback is marked needs_review, but buildPptx only blocks non-pass plan-backed slides; ExportModal directly calls presentationToDeck and can reach the low-level exporter.
findings.fix: Require exportWithIntegrity for verified export and make buildPptx reject any non-pass provenance/status regardless of source; provide a separately named explicit legacy export if needed.

findings.title: Integrity context and evidence gate contracts are incomplete
findings.problem: The proposed context lacks baseUpdatedAt, snapshot/manifest reference, and a distinct promotion confirmation; assertIntegrityEvidenceForSave is referenced without a report schema or adapter to the existing server lifecycle/check types.
findings.fix: Define shared IntegrityEvidenceReport, assertIntegrityEvidenceForSave, and IntegrityOperationResult signatures with snapshot hash/updatedAt, required cells/statuses, artifacts, write policy, and explicit confirmation; map server lifecycle types to them and reject missing context before writes.

findings.title: Validation schema does not represent complete per-cell evidence
findings.problem: The design requires per viewport/resize clipping, overflow, overlap, parity, font, screenshot, and final status, but current shapes store slide-level screenshots and resize metrics omit parity/font/resource/screenshot fields; exact required sequence is not enforced.
findings.fix: Define a VisualValidationCell for every initial and resize state, validate the exact five-state sequence, and include all required evidence and paths in each cell.

findings.title: Font/resource evidence is not fully propagated to the gate
findings.problem: The prose requires stack, weights, deltas, affected IDs, and API reasons, but VisualFontEvidence does not expose them and hasBlockingMetric does not include image/resource failure semantics.
findings.fix: Define the complete per-cell font/resource contract and aggregation precedence, including required-resource failures, missing APIs, and fallback layout deltas; add all required fixtures.

findings.title: Focused test command paths are not present in workspace source
findings.problem: The prescribed command names exploration and integrity evidence .test.ts paths that were not found under packages/audit source; only the corresponding non-test source/helper paths were found.
findings.fix: Create those workspace tests or correct the commands and record exact resolved paths and exit status.
